pressure_hypothesis.title: Compacted environmental evidence hides recorded result scope and status
pressure_hypothesis.basis: The authentic Compiler observation carries a bounded resource summary, result status, narrow claim boundary, and stale VM input finding. Before this change, compaction retained the measurement summary and observation digest but omitted the other outcome fields.
pressure_hypothesis.actionable_recommendation: Retain bounded outcome meaning and selected structured result facts in compact projections while preserving the complete source digest and exact evidence pointer.
